notes: Client only. God Panel tab bar fix. The 9th tab (FRS) overflowed the fixed 400px panel and clipped off-screen, leaving the FRS tab unreachable. The tab row now wraps to two rows (flex-wrap), tabs gained a min-width so they wrap cleanly, the panel widened 400 to 460px, and the content max-height offset was adjusted for the taller two-row header. No server/DB change. Carries 1.1.8.0 and earlier.
